SELECT policy_observations.observation_key, policy_observations.run_id, policy_observations.deployment_id, policy_observations.policy_hash, policy_observations.cohort, policy_observations.state_namespace, policy_observations.metric_contract_version, policy_observations.terminal_status, policy_observations.latency_seconds, policy_observations.input_tokens, policy_observations.output_tokens, policy_observations.cost, policy_observations.commit_outcome, policy_observations.permission_outcome, policy_observations.structured_result, policy_observations.structured_decision_count, policy_observations.unknown_decision_count, policy_observations.rehearsal_id, policy_observations.operation, policy_observations.server_error_code, policy_observations.fault_injected, policy_observations.injected, policy_observations.observed_at, policy_observations.source_trace_id, policy_observations.created_at 
FROM policy_observations 
WHERE policy_observations.observation_key IN ($2::VARCHAR, $3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR, $7::VARCHAR, $8::VARCHAR, $9::VARCHAR, $10::VARCHAR, $11::VARCHAR, $12::VARCHAR, $13::VARCHAR, $14::VARCHAR, $15::VARCHAR, $16::VARCHAR, $17::VARCHAR, $18::VARCHAR, $19::VARCHAR, $20::VARCHAR, $21::VARCHAR, $22::VARCHAR, $23::VARCHAR, $24::VARCHAR, $25::VARCHAR, $26::VARCHAR, $27::VARCHAR, $28::VARCHAR, $29::VARCHAR, $30::VARCHAR, $31::VARCHAR, $32::VARCHAR, $33::VARCHAR, $34::VARCHAR, $35::VARCHAR, $36::VARCHAR, $37::VARCHAR, $38::VARCHAR, $39::VARCHAR, $40::VARCHAR, $41::VARCHAR) 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER
